capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the nexus, the caller's role and that TAG is invited.

capabilities.name: tag.policy.reporting.read
capabilities.use: Configured materiality and percentage thresholds and reporting lines.

capabilities.name: tag.data.query
capabilities.use: Budget, forecast and operational volumes, read-only.

capabilities.name: tag.review.request
capabilities.use: Route commentary for review before it is shared.

inputs.name: organization, entity, period, comparison basis
inputs.source: TAG harness run context and the user's request

inputs.name: actual results by line and account
budget, forecast or prior-period figures with version
inputs.source: tag.data.query, tag.ledger.trial_balance.read or an identified file from the user

inputs.name: configured thresholds
inputs.source: tag.policy.reporting.read, or labelled proposals agreed with the user

outputs.name: variance table
outputs.description: Variances, materiality flags and the thresholds applied.

outputs.name: variance narratives with drivers
outputs.description: Drivers with amounts and evidence, plus the unexplained remainder.

outputs.name: bridge table
outputs.description: Waterfall from comparison to actual, reconciling exactly.

conditions: Before commentary is shared outside the finance function.
When a material variance has a significant unexplained remainder.
When thresholds used were proposed rather than configured by the organization.
